description: Read-only access to geo-grid rank-tracking configs and their latest run. With `configId`, returns that config's latest run plus per-point results (position, url, and the place name each point was reverse-geocoded to for its location override — null means no override was applied). Without it, lists all grid configs in the project. Reports ORGANIC rank at each point, NEVER local-pack position — the free SERP backend does not parse a local pack. Create a config with create_local_rank_grid_config and trigger a run with run_local_rank_grid.

configId.description: Grid config ID. If omitted, lists all grid configs in the project.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: get_local_rank_grid
